text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that a minor street stop sign be installed at the uncontrolled three-way intersection of Scarbell Drive and Starfire Drive (northwest intersection) in order to clearly define the right-of-way and to regulate traffic flow.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized compulsory stop control for northbound traffic on Scarbell Drive at Starfire Drive (northwest intersection).
